doc: Test-only package: one import per ABI type, used by the self-test guest to prove marshalling in both directions. Never offered to a real guest.

functions.name: mix
functions.doc: Returns a + b + c + d + (e ? 1 : 0) as f64: arguments of every scalar type in one call.

functions.name: str_len
functions.doc: Returns the byte length of s as the host received it.

functions.name: bytes_sum
functions.doc: Returns the sum of the bytes of b.

functions.name: fill
functions.doc: Writes byte i = (seed + i) & 255 for every i < cap of dst; returns cap.

functions.name: make_handle
functions.doc: Creates a host object holding v; returns its handle.

functions.name: handle_value
functions.doc: Value of the host object, or -1 for a bad handle.

functions.name: record
functions.doc: Appends the string to the host's call log (the host test reads it).
